'''19-96 Kinetic Absorption Panels''' were a type of padded [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] was often seen wearing these panels and used them throughout his career.<ref name="Developer Insights" />

==Behind the scenes==
19-96 Kinetic Absorption Panels were created for the multimedia project ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'',<ref name="SoSW">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref> and first appeared in [[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]]<ref name="SotE2">[[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]]</ref>, published [[June 1]], [[1996]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/94-854/Star-Wars-Shadows-of-the-Empire-2-of-6|text=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire #2 (of 6)}}</ref> It was not until [[2021]], however, that they were given an official name, first mentioned by ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' Community Manager "[[CG Doja Fett MINI|Doja Fett]]" in tandem with the announcement that Rendar would be coming to the mobile game. Humorously, the numerical designation of the absorption pads matches the release year of ''Shadows of the Empire''.<ref name="Developer Insights" />
